mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations and reduces risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 from t-test against zero mean return).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% within the past month signals an imminent monetary tightening, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in the last 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in the last 1 month (p-value > 0.05 from t-test against zero mean return).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3% and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in the last 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3% and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in the last 1 month (p-value > 0.05 from t-test against zero mean return).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized), a rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity risk premiums and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in the last 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in the last 1 month (p-value > 0.05 from t-test against zero mean return).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1000 (p-value > 0.05 from t-test against zero mean return).

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS > 200,000 persons) signals a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 200000 (p-value > 0.05 from t-test against zero mean return).

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized) signals a robust economy, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized (p-value > 0.05 from t-test against zero mean return).

mechanism_narrative: Strong residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) signals a robust housing market, supporting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 400000 (p-value > 0.05 from t-test against zero mean return).
